things.label: Sign
lines: A highway sign, face down in the caliche.
Underneath, where the sun never reached, the letters are still white: NORTH 35. SAN ANTONIO 154.

things.label: Gantry
lines: A steel frame over the ramp. Something on it turns to watch whatever passes. A red light says STOP.

things.label: The end of the road
lines: The highway just stops. The rest of it is down there, in pieces, rebar hanging out like roots.

things.label: Door
lines: Shut. Cool air comes from under it.

things.label: Stones
lines: Stones stacked waist high, bleached white. Bones between them, set with care.

things.label: Canopy
lines: A roof on four legs over dead pumps. Open on every side.

things.label: Shutter
lines: The shutter is down. Rust has locked the bottom slats to the sill.

things.label: Water tower
lines: AGUA, painted by hand. Under it, older letters, painted by a different hand.
The pipe down the leg is sweating. The ground under it is green.

things.label: Windmill
lines: The wheel turns. On every upstroke the pump coughs water into the trough.

things.label: Garden
lines: Squash, beans, and something with purple flowers. Every row has been watered today.

things.label: Platform
lines: A shroud on the boards, sewn shut with white thread.

things.label: Water jugs
lines: Six jugs. Two full.

things.label: Door
lines: Shut. No light inside. Whoever lives here is out, or asleep.

things.label: Well
lines: The bucket comes up wet. Somebody's lucky night.

things.label: Flags
lines: Seven flags on seven poles. The colors have all gone the same gray-pink.

things.label: Machine
lines: A small machine on four wheels, mowing the same square of dust it always has. Its blade isn’t turning.

things.label: Bench
lines: A concrete bench. The dust is worn off one end, where somebody sits every night.

things.label: Culvert
lines: The drain goes under the road here. The pipe is black all the way in. Something in there drips.

things.label: Billboard
lines: A billboard on two legs. Paper on paper on paper, all of it peeled. Not one word left.

things.label: Light
lines: Green, then yellow, then red. Then green again.

things.label: Tracks
lines: Little tracks in the dust. Six wheels. They come up out of the drain and go east.

things.label: Stones
lines: Stones stacked waist high, bleached white. Bones between them, set with care.

things.label: Tower
lines: A concrete tower standing out in the white. Halfway up, a dark band all the way round. Above it, the concrete is pale.

things.label: Buoy
lines: A buoy on its side on the dry bed. Every few breaths, its lamp blinks.

things.label: Boat
lines: A boat, sitting level on the crust as if it were floating.

things.label: Ramp
lines: A concrete ramp runs down into the bowl, and keeps going, under the crust.

things.label: Tracks
lines: Two treads, wide as a door, with cross-bars. They cross the whole bowl.
